sloka: विललाप महा बाहुर् भरतः शोक मूर्चितः ।शब्द अपिहित कण्ठः च शोधन अर्थम् उपागतः ॥२-७७-५॥
transliteration: vilalāpa mahā bāhur bharataḥ śoka mūrcitaḥ ।śabda apihita kaṇṭhaḥ ca śodhana artham upāgataḥ ॥2-77-5॥

translations.english: Thereafter at the hour of dawn on the thirteenth day mightyarmed Bharata visited the cemetery to perform the purificatory ceremony. Approaching the place of the funeral pyre of his father, he lamented in the intensity of grief:
